# User Stories — Link Shortener

- **US-1**: As a sharer, I want to paste a long URL and get a short link, so that I can share something tidy.
- **US-2**: As a visitor, I want to open a short link, so that I land on the original URL.
- **US-3**: As a sharer, I want to see how many times my short link was visited, so that I know its reach.
- **US-4**: As a sharer, I want an invalid URL to be rejected, so that I don't create a broken link.
